tests.code: let a = next_id(); let b = next_id(); assert_ne!(a, b);

let mut all: Vec<u64> = std::thread::scope(|s| { let hs: Vec<_> = (0..16).map(|_| s.spawn(|| { (0..100).map(|_| next_id()).collect::<Vec<u64>>() })).collect(); hs.into_iter().flat_map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).collect() }); let n = all.len(); all.sort(); all.dedup(); assert_eq!(all.len(), n);
